competition.headline: Chicago-based Brick is latest bet against screen addiction
competition.summary: Mainstream feature coverage profiles Brick's NFC-tap device/app model, citing a two-year user and a Northwestern professor on screen time's mental-health effects. Reinforces Brick's position as NOMO's most visible direct competitor, tying its focus/mental-health value prop to the same themes NOMO emphasizes for students.

industry.headline: Google, Meta, TikTok Sue to Block California's New Youth Social Media Law
industry.summary: The three platforms filed federal lawsuits to block AB 1709, which bans 'psychologically exploitative' features (personalized recommendations, autoplay) for under-16s. A direct US legal test of regulating addictive design right as NOMO's US GTM is active — a win for California could spur copycat state laws, while platforms may pre-empt with their own off-ramp features.

industry.headline: UK Confirms Plans to Extend Under-16 Social Media Ban to Game Chat and Voice Chat
industry.summary: Online Safety Minister Ian Murray confirmed the under-16 ban will pass by year-end and take effect spring 2027, with new rules extending restrictions to in-game voice/text chat (e.g., Roblox) despite gamer pushback. Confirms the UK's regulatory timeline is firming and widening scope — directly relevant to NOMO's UK pilot and CEO Leonardo's policy engagement.

industry.headline: Snap settles landmark U.S. youth social media harm trial days after Meta
industry.summary: Snap settled a bellwether US trial over addictive design harming minors, following Meta's settlement in the same litigation wave (after Meta's $25B New Mexico judgment and $942M penalty). With Meta, Snap and TikTok all settling or losing, legal/reputational pressure on platforms strengthens the market case for NOMO's off-platform rewards model.

industry.headline: Australia's High Court Hears Under-16 Social Media Ban Challenge as Government Preps Enforcement Lawsuit
industry.summary: Reddit and the Digital Freedom Project are challenging Australia's under-16 ban as unconstitutional; government lawyers countered citing addiction, sleep, depression and anxiety risks. ~5 million accounts have closed since December, though many teens bypass age-verification, and Canberra confirmed it is preparing an enforcement lawsuit against noncompliant platforms. A verdict expected in months will shape global policy debate NOMO's CEO is engaged in across UK/US/AU.

new_candidates.name: Dayo (Dayo Deals)
new_candidates.why_fits: Pays teens cash/gift-card rewards for staying under screen-time limits with brand partners already lined up — the same reward-for-reduced-screen-time model as NOMO's Moments, launched Jan 2026 and actively expanding.

new_candidates.name: The Commons App
new_candidates.why_fits: Rapidly signing K-12 district contracts (Bozeman, Summerville, West Sonoma) under new bell-to-bell phone laws — competes directly with NOMO for the same school procurement budgets NOMO's GTM targets.

new_candidates.name: Snitch
new_candidates.why_fits: Prize-winning UK startup building a friend-based accountability app to cut screen time, overlapping NOMO's social accountability mechanic in the same UK market where NOMO's CEO is active on policy.

new_candidates.name: Vivaly
new_candidates.why_fits: Teen-built app rewarding real-world activity away from phones via leaderboards and social points — directly overlaps NOMO's gamified off-social-media reward mechanic and targets the same 13+ student audience.

new_candidates.name: Zenera
new_candidates.why_fits: New entrant turning screen time into real-world rewards with streaks, milestones and a social leaderboard — core NOMO mechanics not yet on the tracked competitor list.

new_candidates.name: Rogers 'Screen Break' Program
new_candidates.why_fits: A major telco building its own $50M, 5-year in-school youth screen-time behavior program rather than partnering with an app — signals risk that telco GTM targets (like Verizon, Rebel Telecom) could build in-house instead of partnering with NOMO.

new_candidates.name: RepsForReels
new_candidates.why_fits: Earn-screen-time competitor using AI pose detection to verify exercise before unlocking blocked apps in 5-minute slots — a fitness-tied variant of NOMO's reward-for-reduced-screen-time mechanic.

new_candidates.name: Timily ('Earn Your Screen Time')
new_candidates.why_fits: Goal-based app explicitly positioned for older teens 'ready to manage their own screen time' — unlocks app time as a reward for completed goals, the same age segment and mechanic NOMO targets.

new_candidates.name: BrainWin
new_candidates.why_fits: Recently launched (Sept 2026) app blocker that earns 'brain points' for real-life tasks to unlock timed access — a close mirror of NOMO's Moments loop entering the market fresh.

new_candidates.name: CityPASS (Boston / MFA partnership)
new_candidates.why_fits: Bundles mobile tickets across 17 North American destinations (museums, aquariums, observation decks) — extends NOMO's single-venue museum/ticket partners (Fever, GetYourGuide) to city-bundle scale, with the Museum of Fine Arts Boston as a fresh, concrete addition.

new_candidates.name: Topgolf (Youth on Course / First Tee teen access programs)
new_candidates.why_fits: Demonstrated pattern of discounted teen experience access ($5 bay access via Youth on Course, $20 off via First Tee) shows Topgolf already issues tradeable, teen-redeemable credits through youth-org channels — fills an 'active experience' reward gap not covered by NOMO's current ticket/apparel-heavy lineup.

new_candidates.name: Chipotle
new_candidates.why_fits: Relaunched its loyalty program with gamified Gen Z challenges and low-threshold free-item redemptions — would introduce a QSR/food reward category entirely absent from NOMO's current lineup (tickets, apparel, wellness, no food).

new_candidates.name: Rebel Telecom
new_candidates.why_fits: UK MVNO built on child-first digital habits that reinvests revenue into schools and is already engaging UK Parliament on children's digital wellbeing — fills NOMO's currently-empty Telco/MVNO GTM slot and aligns with CEO Leonardo's UK policy work.

new_candidates.name: Pennsylvania Act 117 of 2026 / PA school districts
new_candidates.why_fits: Newly-signed statewide bell-to-bell phone mandate (effective 2027-28), covering Philadelphia's 120,000+ students, creates an immediate procurement window across every PA district for exactly the kind of implementation partner NOMO's US GTM needs now.

new_candidates.name: UK Department for Education / Ofsted phone-free schools mandate
new_candidates.why_fits: Statutory guidance under the Children's Wellbeing and Schools Act 2026 (in force since June) now ties mobile phone policy to Ofsted inspections across all English schools — a major, inspection-linked education GTM opening directly aligned with NOMO's UK pilot.

new_candidates.name: Cheshire East Council / Cheshire Police and Crime Commissioner
new_candidates.why_fits: Working toward making Cheshire the first UK county with phone-blocking technology in all high schools by September 2026, with active funding and pilot-school conversations underway — a concrete, named Municipalities-vertical buyer with a real deadline.

new_candidates.name: Devon County Council
new_candidates.why_fits: Endorsed a countywide school smartphone ban affecting nearly 40,000 pupils and backs the Smartphone Free Childhood campaign — another concrete UK council-level entry point complementing Cheshire East in NOMO's Municipalities GTM vertical.

new_candidates.name: Verizon (Digital Wellness / Phone-Free Fund initiatives)
new_candidates.why_fits: Actively funds student-led screen-free projects (Phone-Free Fund with #HalfTheStory) and runs digital-wellness webinars with the Digital Wellness Lab — a recent, active telco investment in NOMO's exact space, filling the currently-empty US Telco GTM slot.

new_candidates.name: No Social Media November (NoSo November)
new_candidates.why_fits: Grassroots youth movement running school assemblies and detox challenges, targeting 30,000 participants across 40 states — a relationship-driven channel into schools matching NOMO's Faith-based & Youth Orgs and 6-12 Education verticals.

new_candidates.name: #HalfTheStory (California Innovation Council)
new_candidates.why_fits: Embedded teen advisors directly into California state policy discussions on AI, social media and digital wellness alongside the First Partner's office — gives NOMO a policy-connected youth-org channel distinct from pure grassroots campaigns.

new_candidates.name: Under Armour (Protect This Mind)
new_candidates.why_fits: Free student-athlete mental wellness platform reaching 50,000+ athletes with coach pledges puts Under Armour in direct contact with the same school athletic departments NOMO targets in Youth Sports — a GTM-channel play distinct from NOMO's existing Nike/Vans reward partnerships.
